## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{python}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{python}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

## Carga de datos

Primero cargamos el dataset "**Titanic**"

```{python}

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import plotly.express as px

titanic = sns.load_dataset('titanic')
titanic['Survived_label'] = titanic['survived'].map({0: 'No sobrevivio', 1: 'Sobrevivio'})
titanic.head()
```

## Visualizaciones Estadisticas y Dinamicas

### Graficos con Seaborn

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| 

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
sns.boxplot(x='survived', y='age', data=titanic, palette='Set2')
plt.title('Distribución de Edad por Supervivencia')
plt.show()
```
